==================
Header comments and one commit
==================
# git-reword: edit the indented messages.
# Do not edit `commit` lines.

commit 7dcfdad1afb39b697a8632f0c450c555abe7d5b6
    Subject line

    Body line one.
    Body line two.

---

(document
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (blank_line)
  (commit
    (commit_line
      (sha
        (short_sha)))
    (message
      (subject
        (subject_text))
      (blank_line)
      (paragraph
        (message_line
          (text))
        (message_line
          (text))))))

==================
Trailers are only the last paragraph
==================
commit 7dcfdad1afb39b697a8632f0c450c555abe7d5b6
    Subject

    Note: this looks like a trailer but is body text.
    More body.

    Signed-off-by: Ole <ole@example.com>
    # comment inside the trailer block
    Co-Authored-By: Someone <x@y>

---

(document
  (commit
    (commit_line
      (sha
        (short_sha)))
    (message
      (subject
        (subject_text))
      (blank_line)
      (paragraph
        (message_line
          (trailer_key)
          (text))
        (message_line
          (text)))
      (blank_line)
      (paragraph
        (message_line
          (trailer_key)
          (text))
        (message_line
          (text))
        (message_line
          (trailer_key)
          (text))))))
